integrity_note: The mathematical proof gives unrestricted formulas and explicit exceptional cases. Computational tests are corroborative only; no external independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact partition enumerator is restricted to complete bipartite graphs with both parts of size at least two.
Counts concern unordered classes on labelled vertices, not graph-automorphism orbits.
The theorem is mathematical; exhaustive tests cover finitely many graph orders and are not independent proof.
Historical priority has been checked against accessible literature and records but is not independently certified.
title: Complete locating-dominating coalition partition polynomial of complete bipartite graphs
